semantic_hash_method: For each parsed CSV row in original order, encode JSON array [URLs, Headline, Body, Label] with ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':') as UTF-8, append LF, update SHA-256. This hash was computed only for the local source; it was not compared to a fully downloaded mirror.
text_normalization_for_duplicate_audit: re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', value).strip(); preserve case. For text duplicates use normalized Headline + two LF + normalized Body.

quality_interpretation: Repeated and visibly mismatched Body templates suggest source scraping problems. This audit does not prove that every article's native fake/real assignment is factually correct. Preserve the source labels and report the limitations; do not silently remove or relabel records.
url_use: URLs and hostname counts were used only for dataset source verification. Exclude URLs from model text and do not use hostname or fake/real labels to infer topical domain.
